note_on_ambiguity: The report groups Business Email Compromise (BEC) and Email Account Compromise (EAC) into a single combined category ('BEC/EAC'). The 'Hot Topics for 2017' section cites 15,690 complaints and $675 million in losses for this combined category. It is not possible to isolate the figures corresponding exclusively to Organizational Spear Phishing (BEC).
